3.show_notes: When Mike Moll’s social media consultancy grew rapidly, he immediately hired more people. But he soon realized he didn’t have the bandwidth or business infrastructure to scale at the same rate as his clients’ varied requirements. Payroll expenses rose and, eventually, he had to downsize most of the team he built. In this episode, Mike details the specific actions he took to rebuild his team as he fine-tuned his pricing model, simplified and automated key processes, and became stricter about the clients his company works with.
3.guest_criteria: Wants guests who speak concretely about back-office operations, systems, processes, and scaling infrastructure — the people, processes, and tools that let a business grow without breaking. Strong fits are operators, founders, and specialists with real stories about building capacity, structuring/rebuilding teams, downsizing, R&D/tax/fintech, software tools, and profitable scaling (observed from recent episodes and the host's Kasennu framework). Skews practical and detail-oriented ('great for big-picture thinkers who need the operational details') — pitch someone who can teach a real operations lesson, not surface-level advice. No public guest-application page found; observed pitch route https://aliciabutlerpierre.com/contact-alicia/. No stated revenue threshold or exclusions.
3.audience: Small and medium business owners, founders, and operations leaders (global — host cites listeners across 35-68 countries) trying to scale operations profitably and fix back-office/capacity bottlenecks.
